message: Let us think of a more diverged variant of the idea

plan.goal: Produce a more divergent alternative candidate to the selected idea (idea_e45af4c8) for the discriminator/generator synchronization gap.

args.instruction: The user wants a more diverged variant of idea_e45af4c8 ("Decoupling Diversity from D: A Synchronization-Free Anti-Collapse Channel", addressing gap_f19d02aa: discriminator/generator synchronization needed to avoid mode collapse). Take the underlying stance of that idea further out rather than lightly rewording it: push the idea to its extreme so it diverges substantially in mechanism, not just phrasing. For instance, consider removing the discriminator's role in anti-collapse pressure much more radically than adding a side channel, or reframing the entire training regime so that diversity enforcement no longer depends on any adversarial signal at all. Produce a single candidate that is recognizably a different approach from the one in context, while still addressing the same gap.

steps.why: The user wants a fresh candidate that diverges strongly from the currently selected idea, which is a generation task grounded in that idea as its starting point, not a refinement of it.

done_criteria: its title and mechanism differ from idea_e45af4c8
